title: Latin Dance Workout for Beginners & Seniors // Fun 20 minute Cardio Boost!

method.teacher_system: The teacher welcomes participants to a low-impact Latin dance workout, immediately starts marching and breathing, and then moves through a series of rhythmic steps like side salsas and hip circles.
method.signature: Combining gentle low-impact aerobics with fun Latin rhythms specifically tailored for seniors and beginners.

practices.what: March in place with hip movement to get started.
Introduce alternate side salsa steps with arm movements.
Walk forward and backward with side toe taps.

adaptations.adjustment: No equipment needed, just follow along

beliefs.belief: Everyone can follow along with these low-impact moves without needing any equipment.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner to a fun 20-minute Latin dance cardio workout, noting that no equipment is needed and all moves are low impact.

struggles.theme: Feeling uncoordinated or unable to follow steps
Physical limitations, surgeries, and aging bodies

clicked.theme: Being able to keep moving despite mistakes or lack of coordination

requests.theme: Asking for more Latin-themed dance workouts

meant.theme: Bringing joy, mood boost, and comfort during hard times

method.limits: Only the first 600 seconds of the video were analyzed, so any concluding stretches or final remarks beyond 10:00 are not included.
